summary: Executed comprehensive backend (pytest, 17 tests) and frontend (Playwright) testing for BEC Progress Assistant. All backend API endpoints (auth register/login/me, writing analyze via GPT-5.4, sessions CRUD, progress aggregation, 401 protection) pass. Frontend end-to-end flow works: demo login lands on dashboard, /writing accepts text and renders full AnalysisView (scores + grammar issues + word choice + strategic advice), /history lists sessions, session detail opens with full analysis, dashboard shows stat cards + score progression chart + radar + recurring weaknesses + latest strategic advice. Speaking mic recording was skipped per instructions (no synthesised audio).

issues: Axis label 'task_achievement' is clipped on the left side (shows as 'hievement'). Consider shortening label to 'task' or increasing chart margin.

action_items: Minor: Fix radar chart label clipping for 'task_achievement' on Dashboard (Skill breakdown card).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py get_current_user does ObjectId(payload['sub']) without try/except - a tampered/legacy token could raise bson InvalidId as 500 instead of 401. Wrap in try/except and return 401.
Startup seeding is idempotent (updates password if changed) - good. Bcrypt hashes verified as $2b$ format via bcrypt.gensalt().

CORS is allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=True - fastapi will refuse credentials with wildcard. Since frontend uses Bearer tokens (not cookies) this is fine, but if cookies are ever used it will break. Consider explicit origins.
Progress endpoint iterates all sessions in Python - acceptable at MVP scale but should be aggregated in Mongo for large datasets.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 writing sessions via demo user during frontend test; 1 was deleted by backend test cleanup, remainder left for main agent verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully green. Speaking endpoint POST /api/speaking/analyze was NOT exercised (requires real audio). Frontend Speaking page also not tested (mic MediaRecorder). All other flows verified via Playwright. Test file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py uses TEST_ prefix and cleans up its created session in test_session_delete.
